contentBlocks.body: An array stores ordered values. Use indexes to read one item and methods to transform collections.
**Worked example.** The array holds three values in order. Indices start at zero, so the final valid index is 2, one less than the length. An empty array has no first or last element.
Reading names[names.length] produces undefined. Length counts elements; it is not the final index.

**Try a small change.** Predict the length and final valid index after one more name is appended.

Then complete the independent check below without copying the example. Explain the boundary case in words before running it.

knowledgeItems.prompt: What index reads the first item in a JavaScript array?
Return the first tag from an array.
